Monopolistic Lock-In & Daily Paper Risk

  • ×Single-Vendor Monopsony: Ordering from one food distributor with zero price competition or item-level auditing.
  • ×Grease-Stained Dry Erase Boards: New pureed or minced orders missed during the 11:30 AM tray line rush.
  • ×Choking Liability: Inadvertent serving of mechanical soft bread to pureed residents without digital safety interlocks.
  • ×Survey Panic: Scrambling to reconstruct 90 days of food temperatures when state CMS inspectors arrive unannounced.

Deterministic Safety & Open Culinary Economics

  • ✓Multi-Distributor Split MRP: Compares Dennis, Sysco, and US Foods contracts line-by-line, routing to the lowest $/lb price.
  • ✓IDDSI 2.0 Hard-Blocks: Prevents kitchen staff from generating tray cards for texture-mismatched or allergen-flagged meals.

  • ✓1-Click CMS-2567 Binder: Complete HACCP log export with verifiable corrective actions ready in under 10 seconds.
Procurement Economics

Break Distributor Pack Obfuscation. Cut Food Spend by 8–18%.

Distributors intentionally disguise pack sizes (40/4oz vs 2/10 lb) to prevent direct price comparison. Shoreline’s pack normalizer converts every offer to canonical $/lb and $/fl oz metrics.

Operational Subsystems

Four Unified Stations. Zero Clutter.

Designed specifically for the ergonomics of nursing homes, memory care facilities, and senior living dining rooms.

01 / CENSUS & IDDSI SAFETY

Resident Diets & Clinical Order Triage

Maintain active therapeutic diet orders (diabetic, low-sodium, renal, pureed, minced & moist) with zero lag. Connect directly to PointClickCare EHR or import via CSV.

02 / CULINARY PRODUCTION

4-Week Cycle Menu & Recipe Scaler

Plan breakfast, lunch, and dinner cycles with daily alternates. Scale yields instantly for changing daily resident census counts with automated USDA nutritional verification.

03 / LINE KIOSK & HACCP

Touch Tablet for Gloved Line Cooks

Large 48px+ touch targets built for kitchen speed. Cooks tap to view meal tallies, record genuine steam table temps, and print thermal tray cards directly at the line.

04 / PROCUREMENT & SPLIT MRP

Multi-Distributor Split MRP & Price Matrix

Eliminate vendor lock-in. Real-time unit price normalization across Dennis, Sysco, and US Foods with automated split purchase orders saving up to $2.45 per resident day.

Developer & Systems Control

Built with an Open Core. Scriptable via CLI & MCP.

Shoreline ships with an automated terminal CLI, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for clinical AI agents, and a typed REST API.

npm i -g @shoreline/cli
BASH / CONSOLESTABLE API v1
$shorelinesurvey cms-binder --days 90 --format pdf
→ Compiled 1,260 HACCP temperature records. 0 out-of-range F-Tag violations. Exported to cms_binder_2026.pdf
$shorelinepurchasing split-po --optimize lowest-cost
→ Dennis PO #4091: $1,240.50 (24 line items) • Sysco PO #8921: $680.20 (11 line items). Net Savings: $218.40
